headline: AI Labs Holding Encryption Breakthroughs That Could Threaten Global Security
summary: Leading experts and Bank of England officials warn that AI companies may be sitting on bombshell mathematical breakthroughs that could break encryption underpinning global banks and governments.
why: Encryption standards are the foundational pillar of cybersecurity for financial institutions, digital payments, and government communications. Any breakthrough compromising these protocols poses systemic risks to the global economy.
